items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Behavior-preserving extraction of all seven campaign selectors; the existing public import path and FR-01.33 campaign-lane semantics remain unchanged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: All fetch wrappers and their error branches remain in campaignsApi.ts unchanged; selectors have no I/O.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new input boundary, write surface, secret, or executable command was introduced.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Existing 37 selector/API tests remain; a new re-export identity assertion pins the module boundary. The isolated Chromium spec asserts campaign display and checks unexpected console errors.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The pure selector bodies are byte-equivalent and still run through the same public entry point; no additional fetch or computation was introduced.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: campaignSelectors.ts holds the cohesive pure-selection block, campaignsApi.ts retains types and HTTP wrappers; both are under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: The extraction changes only a TypeScript module boundary, not a serialized format or its producer/consumer pair.
